focus_tree = {
	id = duplicate_keys_tree

	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = { add = 10 tag = SOV }
		modifier = { add = 10 tag = RAJ }
	}

	focus = {
		id = duplicate_root
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 10

		# Three separate prerequisite blocks: each is its own AND-ed requirement.
		prerequisite = { focus = dup_a }
		prerequisite = { focus = dup_b focus = dup_c }
		prerequisite = { focus = dup_d }

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }

		# Conditional icons: repeated key, order matters.
		icon = {
			trigger = { has_government = fascism }
			value = GFX_goal_generic_fascism
		}
		icon = {
			trigger = { has_government = communism }
			value = GFX_goal_generic_communism
		}
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_fallback

		completion_reward = { add_political_power = 10 }
		completion_reward = { add_stability = 0.05 }
	}

	focus = { id = dup_a x = -3 y = 0 cost = 1 }
	focus = { id = dup_b x = -1 y = 0 cost = 1 }
	focus = { id = dup_c x = 1 y = 0 cost = 1 }
	focus = { id = dup_d x = 3 y = 0 cost = 1 }
}
